Welcome to St Peter's CE Primary School Cassington
Welcome from the Head Teacher
We are a friendly primary school, with our own nursery, for children from 3 to 11 year olds in the village of Cassington. St Peter’s Church of England Primary School promotes Christian values and fosters an environment of spirituality, creativity and respect where everyone is valued and each child can achieve their full potential. We offer a curriculum that recognises and supports each child as a unique individual.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Peter's CE Primary School Cassington - Late/Absence Procedures
pageCache.text:
Welcome to St Peter's CE Primary School Cassington
Late/Absence Procedures
Late/Absence Procedures
Late / Absence Procedures
If you arrive at school after 8:40am, please take your child into school via the office, where you will need to sign them in by filling in the late book.
Student Absence Procedure
If your child is too ill to come to school, please let us know as soon as possible. You can either phone the school office on 01865 880443 and leave a message with the nature of absence, or email us on office.3651@st-peters.oxon.sch.uk
You can also let us know using the absence function on ParentMail.
On the 1st Day of absence: Parents notify school if their child is absent before 9am. If no contact is made by the parent/carer school will telephone home.
2nd Day: If the child is still absent and no contact has been made by the parent/carer, school will again telephone home.
3rd Day: If the child is still absent and no contact has been made by the parent/carer, school will visit the home.
Application for term-time leave of absence must be made in advance by the parent with whom the child normally resides on the form headed ‘Application for leave of absence during term time’. These may be obtained from the school office.

Welcome to St Peter's CE Primary School Cassington
Children
Reading
St Peter's Book Reviews
We love reading books.
We love talking about books.
We love sharing books.
Use the templates below to write book reviews. Take your time, think about presentation and choose your words carefully; other children's future reading choices depend on you!
Every time you write a book review you will be entered into a prize draw where 5 winners will be randomly picked each week. The more book reviews you write, the more chances you have of winning. Your prize is a brand new book of your choice!
Simply hand your book review into the office where it will be scanned and put on the website. Your original copy will be displayed in the reading area and saved in our book review folders so anyone can enjoy them anytime.
Your enthusiasm for different genres of books could open up a whole new world to other children - what a gift to give!

pageCache.pageTitle: St Peter's CE Primary School Cassington - Forest School
pageCache.text:
Welcome to St Peter's CE Primary School Cassington
Children
Forest School
Forest School
Forest School Passports
During our Forest School sessions the children progress through different skills in Tools, Rope, Fire, Dens and Nature. Once they have achieved all of the skills in Forest School Skills Passport 1 they can move onto Forest School Skills Passport 2. Once they have achieved the skills in Forest School Skills Passport 2 they receive their much anticipated Forest School badge. The children really enjoy working on these various skills and are really proud of their achievements.
Take a look at St Peter's Forest School Passports below...
Forest School Skills Passport 2.pdf PDF File
Forest School Skills Passport 1.pdf PDF File
We've had a wonderful start to the year at Forest School with an incredible amount of learning and fun! We've been busy practising and applying our Forest School skills with tools, dens, rope and fire. We enjoyed collecting our harvest and we've spent time observing the seasonal changes and learning about hibernation and migration.

We have had a fantastic Autumn Term at Forest School. In Apple Tree Class there has been lots of exploring seasonal changes, making and building and lots of imaginative play! In Oak Class we have also taken their DT and Science learning out to Forest School and started working on their Forest School skills such as tools and dens!
If you are unable to get to nature perhaps you could get nature to come to you....! You could watch the miracle of metamorphosis in your own home... (https://www.insectlore.co.uk/)
This term at Forest School we have taken our geography work outside, making and using maps. We've continued to prepare our snacks on the campfire and we enjoyed taking part in the RSPB's Big Gardn Bird Watch.
We are having a great term at Forest School. We have taken our science learning outside and been exploring and explaining the seasonal changes. We have been learning about the fire triangle and been cooking our own snacks on the campfire. We have enjoyed exploring the flooded swamp too! In the coming weeks we shall be learning how to use tools as we design and make our own Christmas tree decorations.... watch this space for more photos!
